title.narrative: Food Systems Resilience Program In Tigray, Ethiopia

description.narrative: The Ethiopian Food Systems Resilience Program has been designed to be implemented in 9 subnational states and 2 City administrations including Tigray. However, due to the ongoing conflict in the Tigray, it will be difficult for the Ministry of Agriculture to carry out effective implementation of program activities. The Government of Ethiopia has assigned UNOPS as a third party implementation partner for the Tigray region for a period of 18 months for supporting rehabilitation and strengthening of agricultural extension and animal health support services. The scope of UNOPS work is to rehabilitate and equip infrastructure that were significantly damaged by the conflict - including rural infrastructure such as farmer-training centers, animal health support services, market and collection centers for agricultural products.
